svg.aria-label: AI engineer finishing a B.S. in Computer Science at ASU in May 2027. I train models, make them faster and check them against real benchmarks. At UNOMi I made our markerless motion capture 2.8x faster at the same accuracy, and on my own I train PPO agents on a CUDA simulator I wrote. I started out keyframing characters by hand, so animation is where I want to take AI next.
